evidence: Characterization of the ALD WO3 thin films has been performed using X-ray diffraction (XRD), field emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM), atomic force microscopy (AFM), and laser spectrometer. The optical properties of the as-deposited ALD WO3 thin films on transparent quartz substrates are displayed in Fig. 4. The as-deposited WO3 thin films surface morphology was characterized by FE-SEM as shown in Fig. 2. The surface roughness of ALD synthesized WO3 films on native oxide covered Si substrates was measured by AFM employed in tapping mode. The optical measurements confirmed that the ALD WO3 thin film possessed a band-gap of ~ 3.28 eV.
